feed.identity_note: The SOS's documented JSON feed (api.sos.ca.gov) answered our named User-Agent with 200s on Nov 3, 8:20 to 8:27 PM PT. Its results site electionresults.sos.ca.gov served an Incapsula bot-check page to the same request (8:18 PM PT), so we never read the site; rows link to it.
feed.election_id_from: The feed names no election. media.sos.ca.gov/media/api-endpoints.csv, read Nov 3 8:23 PM PT, lists these endpoints for 'the California November 3, 2026 Statewide General Election' (status endpoint returns/status/gubernatorial-general, the id used here). Each read confirms the ballot by its measure numbers (feed.expect_props: 1 to 5 and 37 to 45).
feed.query_ids_from: Contest ids from the same endpoints list: 02 to 08 the statewide offices, 16 Superintendent, 14 ... 04 and 06 the two Supreme Court retentions, each with county code 59 (statewide); the SOS allows ten per query.
